page.layout: One printed page: a full-page engraved title page, framed by allegorical figures and an arch. Text lines on the central cartouche (banderole) read top to bottom; a small "Cum Privilegio" script sits below it; two oval vignettes at the foot. Stamps and a digitiser's watermark at the bottom are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Ab Anno cIↄ. Iↄ. LV. usque ad annum cIↄ.

page.notes: Engraving: figures labelled LIBERTAS (left pedestal), HISTORIA (right pedestal), and PRIVILEGIA on the left scroll; a central bust of a man in a cap above the banderole; two oval vignettes at the bottom and two roundels with coats of arms/emblems beside the title. The "L" of LIBRI is partly hidden by a roundel and is read as LIBRI. The Roman numerals in the imprint use the reversed-C form and are rendered as ordinary numerals. Printed text in the vignettes and roundels is not legible enough to transcribe. A library oval stamp and "Digitized by Google" watermark are omitted.
